public.title: 1. Public (anonymous)
public.cond: uadebate.com, the federation's site, in English for now, in cab's look. One header on every page: the UAdebates wordmark in Cedarville Cursive, Home, News, Calendar, Clubs, About, the language slot, Sign in and Cabinet, which leads to cab. One footer: the site pages, cab with its Policy and Terms, and the federation's real addresses (ngo.dfu@ and support@uadebate.com, Telegram). cab's tokens light and dark; at most one gold action per page; no middle dots, no arrows. The calendar is mostly tournaments and shows public events only. About carries the history ported from the Wix About page. Accounts live in cab: sign-in starts there.

user.title: 2. User (signed in)
user.cond: All public pages + an identity from cab's sign-in: the header shows the person and keeps Cabinet, Sign in is gone. Nothing else changes, so only the home page is drawn.

content-manager.title: 3. Content manager
content-manager.cond: All user pages + Edit site: news, the calendar and the club directory. A role on uadebate.com only, granted by an admin: not a cab admin, and cab roles do not grant it. The calendar shows private events too, each with a Public / Private switch; private events never leave this column. Forms follow cab's: the command sits in the bar, one gold action.

admin.title: 4. Admin
admin.cond: All content-manager pages + Roles: grant and revoke the content-manager role for cab accounts. cab roles are never changed from here.

phoenix-api.title: 5. Phoenix API, /api/v1 (uadebate.com)
phoenix-api.cond: Every page verb above maps to one of these, with the same ladder: public reads for everyone, writes for content managers, roles for admins. The site keeps its own content (news, events, directory entries, roles); people and clubs stay cab's. Green = the cab call behind it.
